content.text: Now I'll propose the insertion into § 3.5.

input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations in § 3.5
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement currently addresses only accrued payment obligations on termination, with no right to transition assistance or return of our Content. We have added our standard exit provision: up to six months' transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can work with 90 days of transition assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Content and other Customer data in its possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
